setup.title: Let's get your workspace ready.
setup.description: We check what you already have and install what's missing to get started.
setup.error_check: We couldn't check this computer. Try again.
setup.error_in_flight: Another setup is already running and this window can't follow it. Try again when it finishes.
setup.tips.agents.title: Your agents, your accounts
setup.tips.agents.body: Terminus is an Agentic Development Environment. Use your own AI accounts to orchestrate agents however suits you best.
setup.tips.context.title: Context that powers their work
setup.tips.context.body: You stay in control. Governed context sources help your agents find what they need and focus their work.
setup.tips.workspaces.title: A workspace for every context
setup.tips.workspaces.body: Create as many workspaces as you need. Each one keeps its own settings, accounts and information sources.
setup.tips.memory.title: Learnings that are shared
setup.tips.memory.body: Agents can share memory within the workspace: learnings and decisions that help them collaborate, like a team building knowledge together.
setup.tips.folders.title: How the best teams work
setup.tips.folders.body: Your agents work on your documents the way the best engineers would: each one in its own folder, and once you approve their work it's saved to your project's main folder. It works with cloud folders too.
setup.terminal.title: Installation terminal
setup.terminal.reuse: Compatible tools you already have are reused.
setup.status.partial: The essentials are ready. Some optional tools were not installed.
setup.status.unsupported: This version of macOS is not supported
setup.log.timed_out: {name} is installed but didn't answer in time. It's checked again when Terminus opens.

setup.log.unsupported: This Mac has macOS {version}. Terminus requires macOS {minimum} or later.
setup.log.optional_failed: {name} was not installed. You can retry it from Environment status.
setup.footer: You don't need to type any commands.
setup.repair.running: Installing {name} in the background. You can keep working.
